label: Analyzer (Search)
type: the general analyzer concept - built-in (5 named defaults: inherit/keyword/simple/standard/web) or custom (search:custom-analyzer). Composed of one tokenizer plus character/token filters; see the analyzer-composition scheme.
evidence: Character filters, which remove unwanted characters from search input.
For more information about how to create a custom analyzer, see Create a Custom Analyzer.
relates_to_competency_question: What text-processing pipeline does a Search index apply to a field before it becomes searchable?
